title: I help a decision-maker take one product to a first overseas order, or a first container.
subtitle: For an SME decision-maker, and equally for the decision-maker on one product line. Background: 15 years in international business, including mainland China channels (exclusive stores, wholesale, projects) and team management.
services: Global business development — start from what this one product can actually deliver, then find markets, buyers, and channels worth verifying.
Decisions before commitment — put payment, delivery, responsibility, and unknowns on one surface; the decision-maker chooses the next step.
Business economics / accounting-aware judgment — separate margin, cash, and timing; tax and legal conclusions stay with the appropriate professional.

deliverables.title: A clearer decision question
deliverables.body: What this product needs for a first order: objective, constraints, knowns, and unknowns on one surface.

deliverables.title: A brief the team can continue
deliverables.body: Path, people, commitment, and numbers, written so the team can pick them up.

deliverables.title: A traceable next move
deliverables.body: Evidence to obtain, questions to ask, and the decision that still belongs to the decision-maker.

leverageTitle: HOW I WORK · JUDGMENT FIRST, EXECUTION WITH DISCIPLINE
leverage: Research, comparison, and the brief come first. The decision-maker sets the objective and the boundary; evidence decides what moves forward.
worksTitle: From one product to the first container
worksLead: Four stations: the path, the people, whether to commit, and whether the numbers hold. The four works below stay separate.
works: Overseas Lead Discovery — find the overseas buyers worth reaching first. After the list, Paul takes over: why these accounts, and the first opening.
Commercial Decision Desk — before any commitment, put net contribution, payment, and unknowns on one table. The decision-maker decides.
Trade Profit Navigator — put margin, cash, and the levers worth testing on one surface.
Market Entry Research — includes “From Inquiry to Quote: Six Decision Gates.” Tools prepare the inquiry; a person decides price, risk, and any commitment.
process: Bring one product, an old catalogue, or a first order that is stuck. Clarify the path, the people, the commitment, and the numbers—then decide the next step.
disclaimer: Demo cases use fictional data; outcomes not verified.
